text: Election of the Vice Chair of the Board of Directors of Civic Theatres Toronto under Part H, Section 22, of the Board of Directors of Civic Theatres Toronto Procedures By-law for a term of office ending December 31, 2020, and until a successor is appointed.

The Board of Directors of Civic Theatres Toronto elected Councillor Gary Crawford as Vice-Chair of the Board of Directors of Civic Theatres Toronto until December 31, 2020, and until a successor is appointed.
